metadata.description: Zamith's personal collection of Claude Code skills for reviewing, understanding, orchestrating and deploying software.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Work through PR review feedback and review PRs adversarially, posting findings back to GitHub.

plugins.name: understand
plugins.description: Explain code and changes, walk through a branch piece by piece, trace data across repos, and find deepening refactors.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Run long-lived work through a chief-of-staff session that dispatches workers, or an autonomous issue loop.

plugins.name: deploy
plugins.description: Deploy and host apps on exe.dev VMs with Docker Compose and push-to-deploy.
